limitations: Legacy absent flags retain compatibility; this is not a signature or proof of deployment approval. Existing activation/binding/hash chain remains required.
Root-owned candidate generator/path/artifacts/CI changes are outside this seven-file acceptance and need the separate root validation.
No production source, runtime, broker, installed freeze or state mutation; no model deserialization or external requests by review.
No arbitrary JSON parser or file-system hardening assurance beyond the scoped authority contract.
release_gates_remaining: Combined source commit and exact-source full pack
Candidate-only surface verification and installed active preservation
Hosted checks and new immutable image; no deployment implied
review_findings: All artifact-input report/host boundaries reject explicit candidate or unapproved flags before selecting history, broker inventory or invoking strategy verdicts. Host validates before credentials or observer authentication.
Strict booleans and timezone-aware FROZEN_AT prevent coercion and ambiguous dates. Validation preserves the exact original cutoff and does not replace it with active_forward_cutoff.
Captured freeze bytes are revalidated and replay analysis applies the same authority check, including a candidate with internally matching activation hashes.
Legacy NO_SESSION replay exemption never consumes a cutoff or exposes a strategy gate; a present candidate is still refused.
Regression tests exercise actual collection, publish/replay and bound host flow with transport/auth/history tripwires rather than validator-only checks.
